Question B-002-005-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Send CQ at a speed you can reliably receive, because the reply may come back at about the speed you used.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "At the customary speed for the band": A customary band speed may be too fast or too slow for your actual copying ability.
- sourceIndex 2: "At the highest speed your keyer will operate": The keyer’s maximum speed is irrelevant if you cannot copy the answer.
- sourceIndex 3: "At the highest speed at which you can control the keyer": Control of the keyer does not guarantee receiving skill; receiving reliability sets the sensible calling speed.
